title: Rooftop Flow
blurb: Six rooftop sections with slides, vaults and wall-runs, checkpoints and a finish line.

verification.notes: After fix round 1: spawns on the first rooftop facing the route; sprint reaches the first checkpoint ring at the edge of the gap (the harness never jumps). Simple flat-shaded look, sparse HUD. The model reported only a clean build before the fix round.

fixRounds.issue: Player spawns 2 m from the back edge of the first platform facing -Z, away from the +Z route; idle view shows only background towers, sprint runs off the back. Reported with shoot.mjs repro.
